raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 re-delivers every transaction it contains (326 txn_ids appear twice, 652 rows). The 05:00 copies store txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, e.g. 1768716104000, which is 2026-01-18 06:01:44 UTC and matches the string timestamp on the 02:00 copy. The cast fails on those rows, and without deduplication the gold tables would double-count them.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH p AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM p;"}}
